limitations: Uses World Bank DSSI monthly debt-service pages retrievable at execution time.
Route measures schedule dispersion of 2025 monthly interest and principal obligations, not solvency or default risk.
Countries without a complete retrievable 2025 Total row are UNEVALUABLE / not admitted to numeric route result.
No IMI-7 terminal lock is assigned from payment-schedule dispersion alone.
